name: Electrification of process heat (e-boilers, heat pumps)
principle: Steam and furnace heat are produced from electricity with electrode boilers, industrial heat pumps and electric furnaces. BASF is building a 50 MW heat pump at Ludwigshafen (GIG Karasek) delivering 500,000 t/yr of steam, saving up to 100,000 t CO2e/yr, online mid-2027; BASF, SABIC and Linde started an electric steam-cracker furnace demonstration in April 2024. IEA rates large-scale heat pumps at TRL 9 and steam cracker electrification at TRL 6.

process_steps.name: Heat pump, e-boiler or electric furnace
Steam or process heat to site

performance.basis: 500,000 t/yr steam, just over 3% of Ludwigshafen steam demand; up to 98% lower emissions for formic acid steam

limitations: Depends on competitively priced renewable power
